definitions.explanation: Counter for hours of the day (clock time).

Attached directly to a noun, usually a Sino-Japanese one, to mean 'at the time of' or 'while ... is happening': {離陸|りりく}{時|じ} (at takeoff), {睡眠|すいみん}{時|じ} (during sleep), {緊急|きんきゅう}{時|じ} (in an emergency). It is the compact, written-style equivalent of 〜の{時|とき}, common in announcements, manuals, and notices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧2{時|じ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}まります→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{時|じ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}して→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: In an emergency, press this button.

examples.japanese: ⟦{離陸|りりく}→離陸：05981_ririku⟧{時|じ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧{時|じ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦シートベルト→シートベルト：29083_shiitoberuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{締|し}め→締める：10057_shimeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fasten your seat belt during takeoff and landing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧{時|じ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}→呼吸：02754_kokyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{知|し}った→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: I only learned that there is an illness in which breathing stops during sleep when my doctor told me.

notes:
{時|じ} is the counter for hours when telling time (sense 1), and a suffix meaning 'at the time of' (sense 2).

COUNTING PATTERNS (o'clock):
1: ⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧      6: ⟦{六時|ろくじ}→六時：10982_rokuji⟧
2: {二時|にじ}       7: ⟦{七時|しちじ}→七時：10114_shichiji⟧
3: ⟦{三時|さんじ}→三時：10983_sanji⟧     8: {八時|はちじ}
4: ⟦{四時|よじ}→四時：30328_yoji⟧       9: ⟦{九時|くじ}→九時：10980_kuji⟧
5: ⟦{五時|ごじ}→五時：30899_goji⟧      10: {十時|じゅうじ}

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- 4: ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧じ (not よんじ)
- 7: しちじ or ななじ (ななじ is common in speech, to avoid confusion with いちじ)
- 9: くじ (not きゅうじ)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧: what time?
- ～{時|じ}{半|はん}: half past ~
- ～{時|じ}⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧: exactly ~ o'clock
- ～{時|じ}⟦{頃|ごろ}→頃：00932_goro⟧: around ~ o'clock

RELATED WORDS:
- ～⟦{分|ふん}→分：00928_fun⟧/{分|ぷん}: minutes
- ～⟦{秒|びょう}→秒：00921_byou⟧: seconds
- ～⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: duration in hours

USAGE:
In sense 2, 〜{時|じ} attaches directly to the noun with no ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, and belongs to written and official language: signs, manuals, announcements. In conversation, 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき} is more natural (⟦{離陸|りりく}→離陸：05981_ririku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}).
- ⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧{時|じ}: when in use
- ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧{時|じ}: in a disaster
- ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧{時|じ}: on joining the company
- ⟦{非常時|ひじょうじ}→非常時：30241_hijouji⟧: in an emergency
